label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Google and the wallet is never read.

label: API key secret
help: Wallet reference holding a YouTube Data API key, used for public reads. Never the key itself.

label: OAuth grant secret
help: Wallet reference holding an access token, or JSON with client_id, client_secret and refresh_token. Needed for uploads, changes, private data and channel mine.

label: Credential for reads
help: api_key reads public data with the API key; oauth reads with the grant, including the owner’s private and unlisted videos.

label: Default operation
help: Used when a request gives no operation. playlist_add, upload_video and update_video need Allow changes; playlist_remove needs Allow playlist removals.

label: Operations a request may choose
help: JSON array among search, video_details, channel_uploads, playlist_items, comments, watch_uploads, playlist_add, playlist_remove, upload_video and update_video. The default operation is always allowed.

label: Default channel
help: Channel ID (UC...), @handle, channel URL or mine, used by channel_uploads, watch_uploads and the watch when a request names none.

label: Items per listing (max)
help: Upper bound for one listing; a request limit can only lower it.

label: Allow changes
help: Off by default. Required for playlist_add, upload_video and update_video, and for the file input. Videos are never deleted.

label: Allow playlist removals
help: Off by default. Required for playlist_remove, which takes an item out of a playlist; the video itself stays on YouTube.

label: Upload source folder
help: Local videos may only be uploaded from inside this folder. Required for upload_video; symbolic links leaving it are refused.

label: Upload size limit (bytes)
help: Larger files are refused before any request. Default 268435456 (256 MiB).

label: Default privacy
help: Privacy of uploaded videos when a request gives none; private by default.

label: Default category ID
help: YouTube video category of uploads when a request gives none, for example 22 (People & Blogs) or 27 (Education).

label: Made for kids
help: Audience declaration sent with uploads when a request gives none (selfDeclaredMadeForKids).

label: Notify subscribers
help: Off by default. When on, YouTube may notify the channel’s subscribers about a new upload.

label: Watch new uploads
help: Off by default. In Active Runtime, emits each new upload of the default channel on the changed output. Existing uploads are not replayed.

label: Check interval (s)
help: Time between two checks, at least 300 seconds. Also the minimum spacing of watch_uploads requests.

label: Uploads per check (max)
help: New uploads beyond this number wait for the next check.

label: Emit existing uploads at the first check
help: Off by default: the first check only records the current uploads. On: it also emits the newest ones, up to Uploads per check.

label: Page size
help: Items requested per page; YouTube returns at most 50.

label: Pages per listing (max)
help: Bound on the pages read by one listing, comments request or playlist lookup.

label: Search pages (max)
help: Each search page costs 100 quota units of the 10,000 a Google Cloud project gets per day by default.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one request or one watch check, token exchange and retries included.

label: Upload deadline (s)
help: Total time for one upload_video, every chunk and resumption included.

label: Upload chunk size (bytes)
help: Bytes sent per upload request, a multiple of 262144 (256 KiB). Smaller chunks resend less data after an interruption.

label: Retries
help: Reads and video updates retry after HTTP 429, a rate-limit 403, 5xx or a lost connection; playlist changes only after a rate limit; uploads resume.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.

label: Request size limit (bytes)
help: Bound for one incoming request.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger JSON responses from Google are refused as protocol errors.

label: YouTube API origin
help: Keep https://www.googleapis.com. Another origin receives the credentials; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: OAuth token origin
help: Keep https://oauth2.googleapis.com. Used only with a refresh-token grant; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
